ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Allcargo Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — for subscription to the Rights Issue of Allcargo Group Services Private Limited ("AGSPL"), Associate Company.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Allcargo Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Resignation — Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Resignation of  Mr. Vaishnavkiran Shetty as Non- Executive Director of the company w.e.f. Jun 08, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Allcargo Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Standalone and Consolidated financial results for the quarter and financial year ended March 31, 2026.

Copy of Newspaper Publication — Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication of Unaudited financials results for the quarter and nine months year ended December 31 2025
Outcome of Board Meeting — Allcargo Terminals Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.
Copy of Newspaper Publication — Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication regarding the Pre Issue of Rights Issue of the Company

Rights Issue — Allcargo Terminals Limited has informed the Exchange that Board of Directors at its meeting held on November 10, 2025, has decided to issue equity shares on rights basis in the ratio of 3 : 19, i.e 3 Equity Shares for every 19 Equity Shares held. Issue Price is Rs. 20 per share.
